description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' which renders a header section including a title, a search input, and a button to open a modal for adding reviews. It utilizes theming via the 'useTheme' hook and external icons from 'react-icons/fi'.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a header with a title, search bar, and add review button. It accepts handlers and state as props.
